strategy.rationale: Partition work into three bounded families: player-facing choice/result presentation carrying the complete-run gap and choice capability; authoritative wave/director and authored arena/spatial integrity carrying the wave gap, arena capability, and active issue; and isolated dense-profile instrumentation carrying the performance gap. This materially changes prior evidence-only and camera-tuning treatments by repairing authoritative state and spatial owners.
